elements.note: The whole tool screen (a workflow canvas), darkened and blurred.

Spotlight: the one element being explained (a node of the workflow) stays sharp and bright, a little enlarged, with a soft white glow around its box, while everything else is dimmed and blurred. TikMaker's highlight only draws an outline; a spotlight (dim + blur outside a box) would be a new effect.

note: Explaining one part of a busy screen: dim and blur the rest, keep the part sharp and glowing. Captions under it in heavy white italic with a black outline, the key word in glowing green.
